title: Schedule of Servicing Fees: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Late Charge Figures
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — late charge figures by tier.** The product's late charge figures are the same on every tier.

| Tier | Grace period (calendar days after the installment due date) | Late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment | Company maximum late charge per installment (USD) | Minimum unpaid installment portion for a late charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 10 | 5 percent | 30.00 | 10.00 |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Grace period:** the 10 calendar days that follow an installment due date before a late charge may be assessed.
- **Late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment:** 5 percent, the percentage of the unpaid portion of the installment that a late charge represents.
- **Company maximum late charge:** 30.00 dollars per installment, the company's ceiling before the contract's own state maximum late charge (recorded on the contract at booking) is applied; the lower of the two is the ceiling.
- **Minimum unpaid installment portion:** 10.00 dollars; an unpaid portion below 10.00 dollars carries no late charge, and a portion of exactly 10.00 dollars is not below it.

*Hypothetical illustration of the ceiling:* where a contract records a state maximum late charge of 25.00 dollars, the ceiling is 25.00 dollars, the lower of 30.00 and 25.00; where it records 50.00 dollars, the ceiling is the 30.00 dollar company maximum.
